# Mltply

> Mltply is a complete times tables package: a free iPhone app where Buddy the robot asks maths questions in a chat, plus printable maths workbooks for Years 1 to 7.

App available now on the App Store; printable workbooks on Gumroad and Etsy.

Key facts:

- App: free for iPhone, with no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions and no sign-up; open source on GitHub
- Workbooks: printable PDF maths workbooks for Years 1 to 7 following England's national curriculum, with answers
- Where to buy workbooks: Gumroad (https://shop.thechels.uk) and Etsy (https://www.etsy.com/shop/thechelsuk); on Etsy single workbooks start from £4.79 and the Years 1 to 7 bundle is £17.99
- Privacy: progress stays on the child's device; no data sharing
- Developer: Mat Benfield (thechelsuk), made in the UK

## Features

- Chat-style practice with Buddy the robot
- Times tables 1 to 12
- Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division
- In-order or shuffled questions
- Streaks and achievements
- Timed rounds from Starter to GOAT

## FAQ

### Is the Mltply app really free?

Yes. There are no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions and no sign-up. The code is open source on GitHub.

### What do the printable workbooks cover?

Times tables 2 to 12 and division, addition and subtraction, fractions, squares, cubes and roots, and KS2 SATs arithmetic practice papers, for Years 1 to 7 following England's national curriculum.

### Do the workbooks include answers?

Yes. Every answer is worked out and checked by computer, so marking takes minutes.

### Where can I buy the workbooks?

As instant PDF downloads on Gumroad and Etsy. On Etsy, single workbooks start from £4.79 and the Years 1 to 7 bundle is £17.99.

### Does my child's data leave the device?

No. Progress stays on your child's device and nothing is shared.
